sections.text: Introduction

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection on he protection relays operation, 
which must be performed every 3000 hours of operation for motor

This 
procedure was applied in ABU QIR power plant since 1985 and the final draft is 
issued on May 2005

The first draft initiated and tested by eng Ahmed Mhareem, accepted 
 by general manager eng Mohamed Abd Elsadik Ahmed, approved by eng Aly Anor 
 El-Faumy and certified by eng.Mona A Al Sherqawy WDEPC quality control & 
 inspection head sector.
Safety Precautions
The transformer must be was isolated.

Make sure CT Secondary circuits are 
shorted.
